lines.text: The Spirit brings Ezekiel to the east gate, where twenty-five men are, and the LORD says they plot evil.
The LORD says He will remove them from the city and deliver them into the hands of foreigners.
God promises to remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of bronze.
The glory of the LORD stands over the mountain east of the city, and Ezekiel tells the exiles everything the LORD showed him.

problems.problem: "Egyptians" and "foreigners" aren't the same kind of thing (one is a name, one isn't).
The verses say the men were at the gate, not that they were standing.
The printed verses do not identify those addressed as men.
Ezekiel told the exiles everything the LORD had shown him, not simply everything.
